```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install -g pnpm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Authenticate as octavia-bot
        uses: tibdex/github-app-token@v1
        id: generate_token
        with:
          app_id: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private_key: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Run prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
        run: npx pnpm run prepare-embedded-api-spec -- --source https://airbyte-sonar-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/openapi/latest/app.json --output docs/api-reference/sonar-api-spec.json

      - name: Format spec with prettier
        run: npx pnpm run format -- docs/api-reference/sonar-api-spec.json

      - name: Check if spec has changed
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code docs/api-reference/sonar-api-spec.json || echo "::set-output name=has_changes::true"

      - name: Create PR if changes exist
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          gh pr create \
            --title "Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache" \
            --body "Automatically regenerated the cached Sonar API spec." \
            --label auto-merge,autogenerated,documentation \
            --base main \
            --head regenerate-sonar-api-spec
```
